prerequisites: Should be carried out from the 4th year onwards. Students must also meet the requirements established by the specific regulations of the University of Jaén and the Center itself.
Students with specific educational support needs must notify the Student Support Service for corresponding curricular adaptation.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to work, lead, and manage conflicts in a multidisciplinary group and/or a multilingual environment.
Ability to transmit information orally and in writing, adapted to the audience.
Ability to apply new technologies, including information and communication technologies.
Ability to manage information, handle and apply technical specifications and legislation necessary for engineering practice.
Respect for human rights and for those with disabilities, and willingness to eliminate discriminatory factors based on gender, origin, etc.
Capacity for entrepreneurship and entrepreneurial culture.

syllabus_topics: Supervised internships in companies or public or private organizations where relevant agreements have been established.
Preparation of an external internship report by the student.
Consultation with various supervisors on issues related to the execution of the internships and/or the preparation of the internship report.
teaching_methods: Study of procedures/cases in a professional setting

assessment_methods.method: Report from the tutor of the collaborating entity

assessment_rules: The evaluation will be based on the report from the collaborating entity's tutor (50%) and the student's final report (50%). It is essential to submit the final report; failure to do so will result in an unfavorable final report and a "Not Presented" grade for the course. A grade above 5 will indicate that the student has acquired the defined competencies for this course. Grades will be recorded in the official transcripts for the immediate following call.
